tools.name: coder_library_search
tools.description: Search Aily libraries using the shared Blockly libraries.json and libraries-index.json from the main application. Results return exact blockly:@aily-project/lib-* libraryRef, packageName, version, compatibility, activeArchitectures, compatibleAlternatives, installedVersion, installed and managed. An npm package alone is not ready for Coder: source must exist under sketch/libraries. Copy returned refs and versions; for removal require installed=true and managed=true and use installedVersion. Existing managed ZIP libraries remain discoverable for removal.

query.description: Prefer an exact library name when known. Additional functionality keywords are ranking hints; verify actual capabilities from result metadata and the installed API.

forceRefresh.description: Refresh the shared Blockly library catalogs from the selected regional resource.

tools.name: coder_library_install
tools.description: Install one exact result from coder_library_search. Incompatible libraries are rejected unless allowIncompatible=true. Use that override only when the user explicitly requested this named library and confirmed after being told the supported/current architectures and compatible alternatives; if that confirmation UI times out, is skipped, or is unavailable, the original explicit install request remains authoritative and the override may be used, but the final response must disclose the incompatibility and alternatives. Never override compatibility for an Agent-selected library. The Coder Runtime uses the shared Blockly npm package and registry configuration, retains the root package.json dependency and node_modules package, and safely extracts its src.7z into sketch/libraries. Require ready=true, packageJsonLinked=true and non-empty libraryRoots; inspect returned packageDirectory, sourceDirectory and libraryRoots. Copy libraryRef and version exactly; do not invoke npm or extract archives manually.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef returned by coder_library_search.

allowIncompatible.description: Explicit compatibility override. Set true only for a user-named library after confirmation, or when that confirmation timed out, was skipped, or was unavailable while the user's original request explicitly required installing this library.

tools.name: coder_library_remove
tools.description: Remove one exact installed Aily library using its project-local managed receipt. First search and require installed=true and managed=true; copy libraryRef and installedVersion. Shared Blockly packages are uninstalled from root npm dependencies and their unchanged managed sketch/libraries roots are removed. Removal does not require an online catalog. Preserve local, copied, modified, malformed or differently sourced libraries. Existing managed ZIP libraries remain removable by their original refs.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef originally returned by coder_library_search.

version.description: Exact installedVersion returned by coder_library_search; do not substitute the catalog's selected version.
